name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet and Russian chemist, organizer of the scientific school of Chemistry of highly organized substances, and co-inventor of the molecular layering method.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Soviet and Russian chemist, graduate student of Aleskovskii, and co-inventor of the molecular layering method.

name: T. Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist and inventor of the atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) method.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
aliases: Saint Petersburg State Technological Institute (Technical University)
summary: Russian technical university where Aleskovskii and Kol'tsov conducted most of their research and teaching.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: Russian university where Aleskovskii served as rector and founded the Department of Solid State Chemistry.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow after graduation.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: Soviet scientific academy of which Aleskovskii became a corresponding member.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: Rostov region
summary: Region in the USSR where Kol'tsov was born.

name: Leningrad
summary: City in Russia where Aleskovskii studied and worked.

name: Molecular Layering
summary: Gas-phase layer by layer deposition technology for synthesizing solids with predetermined composition.

name: Framework Hypothesis
